title: Resorces for ADHDer
description: This Datapack + Resourcepack will help you if you have ADHD. You can add animations and videos to the screen to distract you while you're doing your routine.
body:
# Information:
This modification is for people with ADHD. We've developed a mod-free modification specifically for these users. It adds interesting effects that can capture your attention while you're busy with routine tasks.

The first effect is a logo. This logo hits the screen and changes colors depending on the impact. Our experts rate this effect 4/10.

![1](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9ed5c972874d3f275581bf0d098e1d82ad57ce26.png)


The second effect is soap cutting. This video in the upper right corner of the screen shows soap being cut. It's very captivating, rated 9/10 by our experts. It makes you want to look at that side of the screen.

![2](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ae064a1541b6967f05acd36256fd6885ac09d245_0.webp)


The third effect is the stock market. This small panel just below and to the right of the soap cutting represents stocks. They fluctuate between up and down, and our experts rate this effect as an acquired taste, so it's a 5/10.

![3](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7835abee58791d88f9d2f6dd79ad63a59bbc3a46.png)


# Settings:

Commands for chat:
```
/function vecsmodel:logo_(true/false) - Logo.
/function vecsmodel:shop_(true/false) - Exchange.
/function vecsmodel:soap_cuttings_(true/false) - Soap cutting.
```
